question: Ratio of days having negative gdp growth to total days
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gdp_growth < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM finance_economics_dataset;
answer: The ratio of days with negative GDP growth to the total number of days is 31.57%. This means that approximately 31.57% of the time, the GDP experienced a decline.
